Fixed 2026-11-22, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#679, companion of #632; RULES 21). blow-off against blow-on in
breeders-x4 and in breeders-x8 (4 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts each (72 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. A world's arms are compared only
within that world. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world; each
arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and class:
deaths and causes (breeders and poison apart), CL and DL, paired rescued and newly killed; per arm "# Refusing flight Recall" notes per game (both
reasons) and flight Recall reads, the "# Flight Recall forecast: ... (#880)" notes, deaths during a pending Recall. A breeder world is a stress test; a
lead needs the normal-world result of #632 (no outcome changed in 360 starts) to be read with it. Directional (RULES 14).
